notes: All three windows average 1000 TensorBoard updates; the early window excludes the first 100 startup updates.

Failure values are means of per-reset-batch ratios, then control-step/rank/update averages, with empty categories recorded as zero. They are not pooled episode failure probabilities or match fall rates.
No per-category failure/episode counts were saved, so pooled common/stress failure rates cannot be reconstructed.
Recovery time includes successful recovery events only; batches with no successful recovery record zero.
Timeouts are event counts per finished episode; multiple events per episode are possible. No-hit episode zero values are included.
Extra displacement is an episode maximum averaged over finished episodes; no-hit episode zero values are included.
Episode duration averages each rank's rolling last 100 finished episodes, then ranks and updates; episode cap is 20 seconds.
Command error metrics divide episode-cumulative error by fixed 6 seconds, not actual elapsed episode duration. They are not velocity MAE/RMSE.
Terrain difficulty changes during training; windows are not a fixed-difficulty controlled comparison.
